scope: GFX3D/PAR-DENS production-time calibration authority and Phase-B sparse artifact reuse

root_cause.finding: Scheduled fields re-entered resolve_density_resource_limits() under live 9/9/10-worker leases and could launch fresh worker-count-specific FFT/BLAS calibration before the first field progress callback.
root_cause.concurrency_issue: Concurrent calibration used SciPy FFT and process-global threadpoolctl native-thread limits from multiple field threads.
root_cause.fix: Bind the scene-resolved DensityTimeModel in context and inherit it through scheduled/nested density execution so production realization never recalibrates by worker lease.

support_atlas_resource_resolution.before: resource/time model resolution once per source block
support_atlas_resource_resolution.after: resource/time model resolution once per support atlas

remaining_hotspots: Phase-B planning remains serial across independent density species
FFT support-atlas dilation recomputes binary-kernel spectra per source block
Near-static framework-species adaptive density produces extremely fine grids and large direct-pair counts
Sparse isosurface connected-component labeling remains a downstream rendering hotspot
